items.q: Basie, see -- Lester was with Basie.

ctx.x: Basie, see -- Lester was with Basie. Now, everybody -- musicians going to go and see this thing, you know. So Ben said, Hap, hey, where you going? I said, let's go up there and hear the battle between Basie and Hawk. Yeah. All right. I'll pick you up. He had a car, you know. Pick you up -- I said okay. Well, man, (unintelligible) trump that bastard (unintelligible).
